volume.block: Agentic volume — three phrases: year to date · annualised · global markets
volume.year_to_date: sum of Cloudflare account daily requests, all zones, from 2026-01-01 to yesterday (UTC); API days first, the office's own archive drops next, then the wefetch Radar archive reading for a month the API no longer holds (spread evenly over the month), blank otherwise; floored to the leading digit
volume.annualised: trailing-90-day daily average x 365, floored to the nearest 50M; 250M/500M/750M read as ¼/½/¾ billion; never above the phrase
volume.global_markets: gsc.infrastructure.resident_countries + allooloo.record.nodes_live, floored to the leading digit (rendered live by the Worker)
volume.api: Cloudflare GraphQL accounts.httpRequestsOverviewAdaptiveGroups, account dd2832b3…, readable for the last 4w4d only
volume.own_archive: SITE/rails/volume/api/<run-date>.json, immutable drops, one per run
volume.cadence: snapshot on the first of each month (Windows task 'agent-kg volume snapshot'), then deploy

paragraphs: The Agentic Private Office of Matthew Keddy holds, on the record, 4.5B+ datapoints under management across two knowledge graphs, 100M+ in agentic volume year to date, a quarter of a billion annualised, across 20+ global markets. An agentic private office combines the people of the traditional office with the agentic assets of the new era — the agents, the keys, the tenancies and the record — under one signature.

Per the Iceberg Index (MIT and Oak Ridge National Laboratory, arXiv:2510.25137), the change is system-wide and sector-wide: roughly fifteen per cent of the economy is in flux to agentic systems, task by task rather than firm by firm. The assets that shift with those tasks — identities, credentials, doors, records — belong to the person before they belong to any company. The office is where they are held.
